  • 發掘高性價比的二手摺疊手機撿漏選擇，僅需幾百元人民幣即可體驗旗艦級晶片性能。
  • 全面解析 Motorola Razr 2022 的外觀做工、螢幕素質以及與三星摺疊機的對比差異。
  • 探索全功能 Type-C 視訊輸出與 Ready For 系統的強大擴充玩法，讓手機能輕鬆變身大平板或迷你電腦。

摘要

百元級二手摺疊神機：Motorola Razr 2022 亮相

作者指出，在摺疊螢幕手機話題熱度持續高漲的情況下，除了熱門的三星機型，市場上還有一款極具性價比的神機——Motorola Razr 2022。這款手機搭載台積電代工的高通驍龍 8+ Gen 1處理器，擺脫了過去的發熱問題，二手 8+256GB 國行版本僅需約 650 元即可入手；甚至內螢幕損壞但支援視訊輸出的 12+512GB 頂配版本只要 389 元。作者進行開箱後發現，雖然鉸鏈部分有明顯磨損掉漆且外觀較為粗獷寬大，不如三星精緻，但考慮到極為低廉的價格，依然相當具有吸引力。

螢幕水準、外螢幕應用與懸停拍照功能

這款國行版本的 Razr 2022 具備全功能 NFC，支援門禁卡、大眾運輸與支付功能。作者實測開啟內螢幕後，讚賞其螢幕素質極高，具備大 R 角設計、護眼模式與防頻閃功能，並支援120Hz 高刷新率與動態調節，整體操作十分流暢乾淨。外螢幕尺寸為 2.75 吋，支援闔蓋後繼續操作應用程式，還能利用主鏡頭進行高畫質自拍。此外，手機鉸鏈支援多角度懸停，摺疊至特定角度時介面會自適應縮放，方便立在桌面上拍照或錄影。

強大的 Ready For 投螢幕生態：手機秒變電腦與大平板

Razr 2022 最令作者驚艷的亮點在於其支援全功能 Type-C 一線連接視訊輸出。即使內螢幕損壞，只要外接可觸控的便攜螢幕，就能直接透過內建的 Ready For 系統進行多種模式切換，包括電腦模式、電視、視訊聊天、遊戲以及顯示鏡像。在電腦模式下，手機端螢幕全黑省電，外接螢幕則呈現完整的大螢幕桌面環境，能自由開啟瀏覽器或 Office 文書軟體，自由度甚至不輸三星 DeX；搭配電視模式更能大螢幕刷短影音，作者認為這款手機能以極低成本魔改成強大的外接遊戲機或大平板，是撿垃圾與折騰愛好者的絕佳首選。

item.title: 大豆包来了！整活儿
item.itunes:title: 大豆包来了！整活儿
item.itunes:author: 老张是大佬
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BXAGxSmm_Ik

值得閱讀的理由

  • 看作者如何把舊玩具車、手機、觸控螢幕與音響改造成能語音互動的「大豆包」。
  • 了解豆包如何透過快捷指令和手機操作，完成跟隨、提醒、查詢資訊與控制應用程式等任務。
  • 從實際示範看見 AI 助理的便利與限制，也思考不需要螢幕的語音裝置能為長者和孩子帶來什麼幫助。

摘要

打造一台「大豆包」

作者認為，豆包雖然已有手機和耳機等產品，卻仍缺少像小愛音箱那樣、能隨時喚醒並接受指令的裝置。由於一般安裝豆包 App 的設備無法使用「豆包豆包」喚醒，作者決定改造舊玩具車，打造一台能移動、能聽指令的「大豆包」。

這套裝置由作者自製的電源、可折疊磁吸觸控螢幕、Hi-Fi 音響，以及能為豆包手機充電並投影畫面的底座組成。組裝完成後，大豆包不但能播放音樂，也保留手機螢幕的觸控功能；作者還打趣說，它的外型像海綿寶寶裡的皮老闆。

讓大豆包跟著作者行動

作者把手機裝上推車，希望大豆包能跟隨自己移動並執行命令，甚至準備了實體靜音按鈕，以備不時之需。透過設定豆包快捷指令，大豆包能切換追蹤模式、取消 UWB 跟隨；作者說出停止跟隨的指令後，它便會停下，也能切換成返回充電位置的模式。

工作時也能協助處理任務

在工作室裡，作者請豆包比較 Intel 工作站處理器的規格，並新增下週一中午回覆粉絲的提醒。作者也示範用語音要求它協助訂麥當勞，以及開啟 Bambu Handy、尋找 3D 列印模型並送到印表機。豆包能辨識 App 畫面、配對印表機並啟動列印，還會回報列印進度、預估時間與設備維護建議；不過作者也注意到推車的轉彎半徑仍不夠理想。

作者對豆包產品的期待

看到豆包能操作應用程式並完成一連串任務，作者感到十分驚訝，也向豆包的開發者和產品經理提出建議：先推出豆包音箱，再發展豆包智慧代理。作者認為，這類裝置不只方便自己，也可能成為家人日常使用的語音助手。

最後，作者讓豆包每隔五秒自動滑動一次短影音。大豆包確實能持續執行，但也顯示自動化功能可能讓人不知不覺看得更久；作者只好趕緊叫它停止，笑稱這種黏著度實在太高。

================================================

Doubao has already released a phone and Olaf headphones, but I think what Doubao is really missing is a device like the Xiaoai speaker. For many children or elderly people, they might not need a screen, but they need to be able to wake up Doubao anytime, anywhere to ask questions or get answers. Or send commands and have it do the work for you. But on any device with the Doubao app, you can't use "Doubao Doubao" to wake it up; only Doubao's own devices can do that. So today, I’m pulling off a big project.

, building an epoch-making product I like to call the "Big Doubao." This is my old "Boy’s Joy Ride," and we’ll...

The setup is basically done. Let me introduce the basic components; I’ve designed it based on the most fundamental functions. First, there’s the DIY car power supply I built, enough to keep it running outdoors for two or three days with no problem, and each channel has its own switch. Okay, for the Big Doubao's face—the screen facing us—I chose a foldable touchscreen, and it’s magnetic. The third part is the voice component; I.

chose a Hi-Fi stereo speaker. I 3 D-printed a base for it, but I’m too lazy to strap it in, so it’s like this for now. You have to admit, it’s loud enough that it would never lose an argument. The fourth part is the dock for the Doubao phone. I DIY’d an all-purpose base—just pop the phone on, it charges automatically, and it mirrors to the screen. Our Big Doubao is alive!

Doesn’t it look like Karen Plankton? Let’s play some music. >> I picked a few classic Mandopop songs for you; just listen. Want a different style or language? Just tell me. Doubao has the Watermelon Music mini-program embedded, so you can play music directly without leaving the app. >> Stop the music. The screen is bigger, and it’s still touch-responsive. See? Isn’t it a Big Doubao?

But being a Big Doubao isn't enough. You might wonder why I put it on something like Karen Plankton's cart— it's because I want the Big Doubao to follow me everywhere and take my commands. To show my respect for AI, I even prepared a small prop. A physical mute button. Hey, just in case. Calling it just "AI" is an understatement; this should be called "Giant-Body Intelligence." Hey, come here, come here, come here, come here, come here!

AI is going crazy, look, it started up immediately. Isn't that neat? Though it's not perfectly tuned yet, Doubao. Stop following me. >> Alright, I won't bother you anymore. Call me whenever you need anything. >> And look. It stopped following me. How is this done? Because I set up a Doubao shortcut. When I tell it to stop following me, it opens this specific link installed in.

its system. Then it switches the tracking mode and cancels the UWB tracking. It even has a "get lost" mode to send it back to its charging station. >> It waits until I need it again. Let me show you how helpful it is in my studio and what it's like when I'm working. What's the difference between Intel's 1370P and 1370? >> You're probably referring to the Xeon W.

-1370 and W-1370P. Workstation processors with LGA1200. Let me check the core count, cache, and integrated graphics for both. You can see it right away, and it'll tell you via voice. Add a reminder for me, next Monday at 12:30 PM. Reply to the fans. >> Got it. Added a reminder to reply to fans for next Monday, November 16th, at 12:30 PM . >> Ah, its turning radius is a bit small.

Doubao, help me order a McDonald's for lunch. >> I'll help you order your McDonald's right away. Open the Bambu Handy app, find the " Benchy" boat in the MakerWorld section, and print it with my A1S printer. >> I will open the specified app and look for the corresponding print model. >> See that? It automatically matches my printer, then it simulates a human tapping the screen. Watch my printer over there, look. Camera feed opened.

Printer starting. I've sent the official 3D Benchy model from Bambu Handy to your A1S printer. Task started: Printing the official classic 3D Benchy test boat. Approximately 11g, 12 minutes and 42 seconds, 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.25 mm layer height, 192 layers total. Device: A1S Texture PEI Plate. Current status: Busy , 0%progress, approximately 27 minutes remaining. The printer has started the first layer contour on the build plate. You can check the progress on the device page. Recommendation: Clean and lubricate the X-axis rails, Y-axis rails , and Z-axis lead screws, as it may affect this print. Feel free to perform maintenance when convenient.

Oh my god, it actually fully understands what the app looks like after opening it . That's insane. To everyone who developed Doubao, and the product managers: I really think this is what ordinary people need. At the very least, create a Doubao speaker first, then a Doubao intelligent agent. If nothing else, my family would definitely have one for everyone. Doubao, Doubao, help me auto-scroll TikTok. Scroll to the next one every five seconds, every five seconds.

Ha, you won't even need to use your hands to scroll TikTok anymore. And look, your big Doubao keeps letting you scroll, look. The stickiness is extremely high. Doubao , stop it, I'm not watching anymore, I'm not watching. I'm not watching.

值得閱讀的理由

  • 揭露市售僅約 4 元人民幣的超低價小米快充線，究竟是誇大不實的數位陷阱還是真具備快充實力。
  • 透過外觀做工、實際握手協議、功率實測到暴力拆解，全方位剖析正品、精仿與劣質山寨線的真實差異。
  • 見證第三方小廠如何破解原廠專有快充協議，呈現出乎意料的性價比與硬體做工真相。

摘要

低價踩坑：外觀與做工的初步對比

作者為尋找評測素材，特意在網路上購買了一條宣稱支援高速充電、售價僅 3.97 元人民幣的小米快充數據線。收到實物後，作者指出包裝外觀雖然仿造原廠，但粗糙的紙盒邊緣以及可自由挑選長度的特點，直接證明其並非原裝正品。然而，這款 1.5 米的仿線採用了標誌性的橙色膠芯與特殊接腳，金屬端子甚至施加了鍍鎳處理，做工與質感遠勝過去那種粗製濫造的劣質假線，外觀模仿水準極高。

協議與功率實測：令人跌破眼鏡的表現

作者隨後拿出小米 100W 原廠充電器進行充電測試。原本作者預期這條超廉價仿線會翻車，沒想到接上手機後，儀表竟然成功握手 16V 電壓並觸發顯示小數點的 100W MAX 快充協議，通過電流亦順利突破 3A；相較之下，以往的廉價劣質假線只能觸發 9V 且功率被死死卡在 12W。這項意外的實測表現讓作者原本準備用來嘲諷山寨線的腳本徹底失效。

暴力拆解：平價線材背後的用料真相

為了探究這條線為何能啟動專有協議，作者進行了暴力拆解。剖開線身後發現，內部不僅配備了金屬屏蔽層，正負極導線也做了加粗處理，端子內部更是完整灌膠，並內建了一顆代號為 2627Y 的無品牌快充協議晶片。儘管比起擁有克維拉抗拉纖維與小米官方專屬晶片的原裝線仍有工藝差距，但這款低價仿線展現出的技術破解與用料，依然讓作者讚嘆民間小廠的逆向研發能力。

================================================

Lately, I’ve been having a bit too much success in the secondhand market, so I’m intentionally looking for some traps to fall into. I want to become the legend of digital landmines. You guys sent in a tip: a Xiaomi data cable for 3.97 yuan. See, they didn't claim it was original, but they say it supports high-speed charging. It’s obviously a trap meant for you guys to laugh at. I bought two, and when they arrived,. they looked just like the standard Xiaomi packaging—QR code and all. But look at these paper edges; it's a fake, no doubt about it. It’s a dead giveaway , right? You could even choose the length when buying this cable. Have you ever seen an original cable where you could pick the length? This is the 1.5-meter version, standard USB-A to Type-C, with that classic Xiaomi orange connector.

There are modified pins inside; honestly , the imitation isn't even that bad. Let’s compare it to an original cable that came with a phone, the 1-meter authentic version. Left is the original , right is the one I bought. Both have factory markings. My original is marked H2, and this 3-yuan cable is Z1. The metal connector actually looks better than the original, in my opinion. Can I say that? >> Yeah, look, you can clearly tell the surface is nickel-plated, right? It’s significantly better. On the back, it even has the standard Xiaomi 6A logo. The 3-yuan cable has pretty bad rough edges. Now look at the original—the original wire is 3.5 mm, while this fake one is… >> My eyes are like a ruler. Now, let’s add a cheap, blatant fake I bought before to compare. Put them side-by-side, and you’ll see this new "fake" one is actually pretty.

well-made, right? Compared to the previous one—this one here is the really cheap fake—the old one is way too rough . On the left is the original, and this is the new 3-yuan one. The craftsmanship is excellent. The cheap one has an integrated Type-C port, but a super low-quality, spliced-together design. So , this new cable is actually a cut above the rest, even though the internal pin layout is a bit different. But they didn’t say it was original, using a 100W original Xiaomi power adapter. Which original cable do you want to see first ? This cable has no E-marker; it uses a. modified Type-A port to output a signal close to the PD protocol. Through the power meter, it can still identify 100W max at 16V. Pushing 30-40 watts. The current is 2.5-2.6 A, passing 3A, it can even exceed 3A. This is a typical characteristic of an original cable. With a 100W phone and a 100W charger, it actually pushes about 72W. For a $ 3 cable, some teardowns show there's a.

chip inside. Even pirate cables can trigger 100W max on the meter and handshake the 16V protocol with decimal points. They start at over 35W and exceed 2A. You'll know if it's real or fake by whether it can pass 3A. It’s stuck, right? No way, that can't be. It can also pass 3A and a bit. Wait, let's try that pure fake cable we had before. See, the fake cable only activates the fast charging. icon without the decimal point. The actual activated voltage is 9V. This definitely can't handle over 3A of current. See, it's firmly pinned at 12W . Was a certain protocol not activated? Let's try it again. See, it’s still stuck at 12W. My prepared script is now useless. >> What do I do with the direction of this show? >> Wow, why does such a magical thing exist ? Stripping it, there’s a metal shield and thickened positive and negative.

wires. Look, there really is a chip, fully potted. It's clearly a protocol chip with no brand. 2627Y200W...Now look at the impressive original one. See that ? A metal-shielded head. So first of all , regardless of charging speed or support for proprietary protocols, this isn't an original cable. Metal strain relief, anti-pull, full of shielding wires, it even has Kevlar—Xiaomi’s. The chip inside the original head has a Xiaomi logo on it, so is this another. small factory in China that got their hands on the technical specifications?

item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rVnsEfrePDQ

值得閱讀的理由

  • 揭密知名企業會議設備大牌 Polycom 會議音箱在二手市場的「撿漏」實測與踩坑真相。
  • 了解專業會議音箱採用 PoE 供電 的限制與家用連接時可能遇到的供電困擾。
  • 實際測試會議音箱播放流行音樂的音質表現，打破「大牌商務設備聽歌一樣出色」的迷思。

摘要

二手撿漏企業級會議揚聲器

作者受到群友的推薦投稿，在二手平台花費 97 元購入了一台知名商務品牌 Polycom（寶利通） 的 Trio 8800 智慧會議音箱。這款設備常見於大型企業會議室，具備多角度收音麥克風、揚聲器及一鍵靜音鍵，並配有一塊小型觸控螢幕與 NFC 模組，但其特殊之處在於機身沒有常規電源孔，完全依賴 PoE 網路孔供電。

繁瑣的供電與卡頓的系統體驗

因為設備未附帶專用變壓器，作者先找來一顆 40W 的 PoE 供電器將其啟動。該設備內建 Android 智慧系統，但實際滑動觸控螢幕時反應極為延遲，操作體驗非常不跟手。此外，作者嘗試使用 NFC 快速配對 藍牙功能也未能成功，最終只能透過手機手動搜尋藍牙完成連線。

音質翻車與刺耳的聽覺體驗

在成功連線並播放音樂後，設備的音質表現令人大失所望。人聲高頻部分的齒音嚴重變形，整體聲音缺乏解析力與動態，聽感極差。作者感嘆這台機器完全只值二手買來的幾十元價格，甚至懷疑自己是否被群友故意推坑開玩笑。

升級供電仍難以挽救

面對攝影師提出是否因供電功率不足導致音質劣化，作者又額外花了 100 元購入 60W 高功率 PoE 供電器進行二次驗證。然而更換強效電源後，其音質依然只有普通廉價電視揚聲器的水準。作者量測後發現內部喇叭單元僅約 2 英吋左右，本質上就是專為人聲會議調校的設備，根本不適合用來聽音樂，徹底宣告撿漏翻車。
